page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.3xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs based on the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, with 6 physical cores and hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 92.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 7.67 GB per core. It includes a single NVIDIA Volta V100 GPU with 32 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance asymmetry. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. However, multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth align with the middle 50% average. The standout capability of this instance lies in its GPU-accelerated workloads. LLM inference benchmarks for small (135M) and medium (7B) models show top-tier performance, with prompt processing and text generation speeds ranking in the top 10% to 25% of tested configurations.

Given the dedicated GPU and substantial VRAM, this instance offers high resource density for parallel computing tasks, though the older Intel CPU architecture presents a tradeoff in single-threaded efficiency. It is highly suitable for deep learning inference, medium-scale AI model execution, and GPU-accelerated data processing. It is less optimal for CPU-bound single-threaded applications or workloads requiring high-speed local NVMe storage.
